newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SENTRASURE REPORTS FAVOURABLE HALF-YEAR RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: SENTRASURE REPORTS FAVOURABLE HALF-YEAR RESULTS.

text.p: Agricultural insurance firm Sentrasure has reported a favourable first half-year until June this year.
Compared to the first half of 1996, gross premium income rose by four percent to 135 million rand, while the underwriting profit almost doubled to 2.1 million rand, Sentrasure said in a statement.
Pre-tax profit for the period increased by eight percent to 24.8 million rand.
Investments were restructured and the improvement in reserves strengthened the solvency margin to 108.3 percent.
Managing director John Moat said the positive results stem from Sentrasure's focus on agricultural and related business.
He said Sentrasure was anchored in agriculture and offered specialised expertise and custom-made cover for the whole range of farming activities and agriculture-based interests countrywide.
